data.title: SpaceX's Cursor Tells Lawmakers It Is Considering Phasing Out Chinese AI Models
data.description: According to CNBC, SpaceX subsidiary Cursor told the House Committee on Homeland Security and the House Select Committee on China that it is considering phasing out Chinese-developed open-weight AI models because of geopolitical risk, a report by the committees said. SpaceX completed its acquisition of Cursor in August at an implied $60 billion equity value. Cursor had built its Composer 2 coding model on Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5.

data.title: India Regulator Proposes Scrapping Key Disclosure Rule to Attract Foreign Money
data.description: According to Bloomberg, India’s market regulator has proposed easing disclosure rules for foreign investors to boost overseas flows into the country.

data.title: Citi Expects Fed to Resume Rate Cuts in 2027 as Markets Signal Rates Are Too High
data.description: According to Sina Finance, Citi said on November 20 that falling stock valuations and rising risks of slower AI investment would limit the Federal Reserve’s scope for further rate hikes, with markets signaling that current rates are too high to sustain. Citi said inflation above the Fed’s 2% target favors further hikes, while tighter financial conditions and the risk of slower AI investment favor cuts; the case for lower rates is gaining ground. U.S. economic growth over the past year has relied largely on AI-related investment. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said in October that the U.S. economy was not overheating and that he did not want to curb growth. Citi said the Fed would have little appetite for further hikes amid a sustained stock-market selloff. It nevertheless expects a 25-basis-point hike in December, as the Fed increasingly prioritizes its credibility in fighting inflation. With market inflation expectations low and energy prices falling, Citi sees the Fed turning dovish quickly in 2027. In its base case, the Fed will hold rates after the December hike and resume cutting them later in 2027.

data.title: H100 Group’s Active Trading Pool Loses 30 Bitcoin in Third Quarter
data.description: According to Odaily, Bitcoin Treasuries said on X that Swedish-listed H100 Group had reported a 30-bitcoin loss in its active trading pool in the third quarter, while its total holdings stood at 3,477 bitcoin.

data.title: STOCKS | Societe Generale: AI Investment and Earnings Support 18.5% S&P 500 Upside
data.description: According to Jin10, Societe Generale expects AI-related investment and corporate earnings to support U.S. stocks, with the S&P 500 reaching 8,500 by the end of 2027, about 18.5% above its Thursday close of 7,175.83. The bank maintained its forecast for 11% earnings growth among S&P 500 constituents in 2027 and expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates twice more by 25 basis points each, with the final hike in March 2027. Societe Generale sees S&P 500 valuations turning upward as the rate-hiking cycle ends and expects the strongest returns in the second quarter. In Europe, the bank forecasts the STOXX Europe 600 will reach 720 by the end of 2027, and says a return of global capital flows to Europe, combined with more favorable seasonal trends in recent years, could support European stocks early in the year. Societe Generale recommends maintaining a higher equity allocation, citing the continued support expected from wider AI adoption, productivity gains, and corporate earnings growth.

data.title: STOCKS | Nvidia Could Extend Losing Streak to Seven Weeks, Longest Since 2008
data.description: According to Jin10, Nvidia shares fell nearly 4% in premarket trading and could post a seventh consecutive weekly decline, the longest such streak since 2008, if they finish the week lower. Nvidia was a core company in the AI boom that drove stock gains in recent years, and current turmoil has intensified concerns about whether the AI rally can continue. Anthropic’s listing failed to lift sector sentiment: its shares closed Thursday nearly 13% below their opening price and fell 13% in premarket trading today. LSEG data showed that 48 of the 65 brokerages covering Nvidia maintained a “buy” or higher rating, with a median price target of $233.50. As of the previous trading session’s close, Nvidia was down 21.7% year to date, while the S&P 500 was up 4.8%.

data.title: HeartSciences Shareholders Approve Fortitude Merger With About 86% of Votes
data.description:
HeartSciences shareholders approved the company’s previously announced business combination with Fortitude with about 86% of votes at a special meeting on November 19. According to Odaily, Fortitude Mining Holdings said the transaction remains subject to outstanding closing conditions, including Nasdaq approval to list the combined company.

After closing, the combined company will be renamed Fortitude Mining Group, and its Class A common stock is expected to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker TUDE. The company will appoint Elizabeth B. Higgins and Simcha Wurtzel as independent directors. Fortitude is a vertically integrated Zcash mining platform led by CEO Jaime Leverton.

data.title: Anthropic’s Valuation Needs Time to Digest, Analyst Says, Citing Growth Questions
data.description: Anthropic needs much faster revenue growth over the next two years to support its valuation, Seaport Research Partners analyst Jay Goldberg said. According to Odaily, Goldberg expressed concern about a sharp slowdown in the company’s third-quarter growth and said it may not improve much in the fourth quarter. He called Anthropic an impressive company but said its valuation requires substantial investor confidence. Goldberg said the company needs time to digest its valuation and address major questions about its growth trajectory. He said he was cautious, not bearish, on the stock and assigned it a Neutral rating.

data.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde Says Europe Could Lose Control of Tokenized Asset Market
data.description:
European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said Europe could lose control of the fast-growing tokenized-asset market if EU lawmakers fail to establish unified rules soon. According to Foresight News, citing CoinDesk, Lagarde said the bloc could also miss the opportunity to build a single market for digital assets.

The global market for traditional assets tokenized on public blockchains reached about 23 billion euros in March this year, five times its size a year earlier, she said. Lagarde said tokenization could help Europe create an integrated digital-asset market, but technology infrastructure alone would not be enough.

The ECB launched its Pontes platform in September to support settlement of tokenized securities in central bank money. Earlier this month, the European Stability Mechanism settled a 1 billion euro digitally native bond through the platform. Lagarde said that without a common legislative framework, blockchain platforms could struggle to interoperate, leading to a fragmented market.

data.title: VIX Rises to 31, Highest Since March 30
data.description: According to Jin10, the VIX rose to 31, its highest level since March 30.

data.title: Stablecoin Market Cap Falls $4.56B in a Week, Down 1.6%
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing DefiLlama, the total stablecoin market capitalization fell by about $4.56 billion over the past week to approximately $284.17 billion, a decline of about 1.6%. USDS, USDC, and USDT recorded the largest outflows.

data.title: Lagarde Says EU Funds Should Take First Losses on Chip Plants, Data Centers
data.description: According to CNBC, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said Friday that EU public funds, including money from the EU budget, should absorb initial losses on major chip-plant and data-center projects to attract private capital. She made the proposal in her final address to the Frankfurt European Banking Congress before stepping down as ECB president in February.

data.title: Trump Says U.S. Financial System Is Decades Outdated and Needs a Crypto Upgrade
data.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said the U.S. financial system has relied on outdated infrastructure for decades and needs an upgrade using cryptocurrency technology. According to Odaily, Bitcoin News wrote on X that payments and money transfers can take days or even weeks to clear, and Trump said new legislation would allow the system to undergo a 21st-century upgrade using advanced cryptocurrency technology.

data.title: MMG Faces Fresh EU Opposition to $500 Million Anglo American Deal in Brazil
data.description: According to Bloomberg, MMG Ltd. faces mounting European Union opposition to its planned $500 million deal with Anglo American in Brazil. EU watchdogs cited fresh evidence of a threat to future supplies of vital ferro nickel to the bloc’s stainless-steel industry.

data.title: U.S. Justice Department and Infiniweb Reach Agreement in Principle in 225 Million USDT Forfeiture Case
data.description: The U.S. Justice Department and Infiniweb have reached an agreement in principle in a case seeking forfeiture of 225 million USDT. According to Odaily, a joint status report published November 4 by the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia said the U.S. government, Infiniweb and other claimants reached a preliminary settlement concerning 225,364,961 USDT. The agreement remains subject to due diligence and review and approval under Justice Department policy, and has not been finalized or signed. It does not cover several pending motions filed by another claimant, Nivedita Kaul, which the court will consider separately. The court stayed the case on August 7 and ordered the parties to submit progress reports every 30 days.

data.title: TradFi News | Ark Invest Buys $90 Million of Anthropic Shares on Record IPO Debut, Trims Nvidia
data.description:
Cathie Wood’s Ark Invest bought more than $90 million of Anthropic stock on the AI company’s first day of trading on Nasdaq, according to Ark’s trading update. The firm bought about 935,000 shares across six funds on Thursday, November 19, and sold about 33,430 Nvidia shares worth $4.9 million. Anthropic raised $81.3 billion by selling 980 million shares at $83 each, topping SpaceX’s $75 billion June listing as the largest IPO on record, according to CoinDesk.
ARKK Accounts for Most of Ark’s Anthropic Purchase
Ark’s flagship ARK Innovation ETF (ARKK) bought 556,777 Anthropic shares, about 60% of the firm’s total purchase and worth roughly $54 million at Thursday’s close (calculated). The rest was split across five other Ark funds.

Despite the purchase, Anthropic sits outside Ark’s top 10 holdings. Those are led by Tesla, SpaceX, Tempus AI and Amazon.
The Anthropic buy is far smaller than Ark’s SpaceX trade. On SpaceX’s IPO day in June, Ark bought 3.3 million shares worth about $500 million.
Anthropic Closes 17% Above IPO Price After Volatile Debut
Anthropic, which trades under the ticker ANT, priced its shares at $83, above its $70–$78 range, and opened at $111.50. The stock closed at $97.17, up 17.1% from the IPO price (calculated). That was 13% below the open and 16% below the intraday high. Almost 850 million shares changed hands on the first day.

Ark Sells Nvidia as Shares Keep Falling
Ark sold about 33,430 Nvidia shares on the same day, worth about $4.9 million at the close. Nvidia ended Thursday at $145.98, down about 4% from Wednesday. The company is led by interim CEO Colette Kress following Jensen Huang’s departure on November 12.
Nvidia shares have fallen since the company’s earnings beat on Tuesday. UBS cut its price target to $220 from $240, its second cut in three days, and JPMorgan analysts said the results did not resolve concerns over AI demand and financing.

data.title: Binance Extends USD1 Rewards Campaign With Estimated APR Up to 10%
data.description: Binance announced on X that it has extended its USD1 rewards campaign and expanded the reward pool. Users who hold USD1 in any account can receive an estimated APR of up to 10%.

data.title: GaoTeng Bitcoin ETF Lists on Hong Kong Stock Exchange as New Huo Invests About $10 Million
data.description: The GaoTeng Bitcoin ETF listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange today, with New Huo Group participating in its cornerstone investment with about $10 million. According to Foresight News, New Huo Asset Management, a subsidiary of New Huo Group Holdings Limited (01611.HK), made the investment in GaoTeng International Asset Management’s Bitcoin ETF project. The companies will cooperate on digital asset investment products, institutional client services and digital asset wealth management, and may explore tokenized funds and the joint issuance of other digital asset products. GaoTeng International holds Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission licenses for Type 1, Type 4 and Type 9 regulated activities and is an asset manager backed by investments from Hillhouse Capital Group and Tencent.

data.title: TPG and Corpay to Acquire Bill in Deal Valued at About $6 Billion
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, TPG and Corpay will acquire Bill Holdings in a deal valued at about $6 billion, with TPG taking a majority stake and Corpay a minority stake. Bill's largest shareholder, Starboard Value, has agreed to support the offer of $63.25 per share. The transaction requires regulatory and shareholder approvals and is expected to close in the first half of 2027. Founder René Lacerte will remain CEO after the deal closes.

Bill closed at $57.63 on Monday. Its shares surged after the Financial Times reported that TPG was nearing a deal, then fell 4% in Thursday's after-hours trading to $61.51.

Lacerte said the new partners would provide capital, expertise and strategic support to accelerate product innovation and Bill's AI transformation. On November 5, Bill reported first-quarter revenue rose 13% year over year to $358.3 million. The company went public in 2019 and announced in May that it would cut about 30% of its workforce to improve profitability and focus resources on AI.

Starboard planned to nominate board candidates at Bill's 2025 annual meeting, but the two sides reached a cooperation agreement in October 2025. TPG and Corpay also jointly acquired business payments provider AvidXchange in October 2025.
